note: Property-related taxes. The state fastighetsskatt on homes was abolished 2008 and replaced by the capped kommunal fastighetsavgift: 0.75 % of taxeringsvärde, at most 10 074 kr for småhus (inkomstår 2025 / deklaration 2026; the cap is indexed). Before the reform the state tax ran at 1.0–1.5 % of taxeringsvärde with no cap. Egendomsskatter as share of GDP: Sweden ≈ 1.0 %, EU-15 ≈ 2.3 % (LO/SNS compilations of OECD data). Ränteavdrag: 30 % of interest up to 100 000 kr/yr, 21 % above.
